build: Compare a commercial product's orders, forecast stock and recorded marketable picking in the same week.

changes.did: Weekly buyer demand shows forecast stock against orders, alongside the expected picking and the marketable quantity actually picked.
steps: In Forecast, open Buyer demand and select the crop, selling unit and week. Review how much forecast stock is above or below the orders.
Record a harvest in Tasks and return to the same week to compare the marketable picking with orders. The comparison uses plantings currently grown for sale and shows their culls separately.
A buyer week always runs Monday through Sunday, including when it crosses New Year.
